tools.name: search_directory
tools.description: Keyword search of the Ni Biashara directory of African and Caribbean diaspora businesses in the US, Canada and beyond, optionally filtered by city, metro and category. Listings are compiled from public sources.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: One Ni Biashara listing by its id (from search_directory results or a nibiashara.com/b/<id>/ link): name, category, city, metro, phone, website, social links, status and the listing and claim links.

tools.name: directory_facets
tools.description: Live listing counts for the whole Ni Biashara directory: total, per metro area and per category. Useful for sizing diaspora business communities by city or sector.
